answer: Because the timing is written down against the trellis challenge, the nectar audit can replay the mesa history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 120 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 246 aliases cost 100 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
